── MARISOL'S WEEK ──
Marisol is training for a second marathon, the Wexley Lakes Marathon, aiming to break 3:45 after a 4:02 debut. Marisol runs five days a week, with a session on Wednesday, the long run on Sunday and Monday and Friday off, and ran about 30 miles a week before this build.
Recent weeks: 53, 40, 42, 46 mi
This week: 34 mi over 5 runs.
Body: "Legs heavy and flat. Nothing hurts, they just feel dead."
Feeling: "Nervous. I feel like I'm losing fitness."
Asks: "Is it crazy to do one more 16-miler on Wednesday so I feel ready?"

── THE DRAFT ──
Tells Marisol: Race week is here, and the heavy legs you are feeling are the taper working, not fitness slipping away. …
Answers: No, do not add a 16-miler on Wednesday. Six days out, a long run cannot build fitness, it can only take sharpness and freshness away from Sunday.
Next week:
Mon: rest. Full day off to start the taper and let the last long run clear.
Tue: easy, 5 mi, heart rate under 145, flat route, finish with 4 x 20 sec strides. Keeps…
Wed: quality, 5 mi, with 2 mi at goal pace around 8:34/mi in the middle, easy either…
Thu: easy, 4 mi, heart rate under 140, flat and relaxed. Light flush between the pace…
Fri: rest. Protect sleep, hydrate, and start topping up carbs today.
Sat: easy, 2 mi, very easy with 3 x 20 sec strides at the end. Shakeout only, stay off…
Sun: race, 26.2 mi, first 10 mi at 8:35 to 8:40, settle to 8:30 to 8:35 through 20, race…
